name: Dhivya Govindaraj
message: We are blessed to have been invited by you to have our memories back. It’s our pleasure to participate in the event. We were stunned by collection. This is such a huge collection that I have ever seen in my life. May god bless you and your family with good health and wealth. I was once again dumbstruck by reading your blog. Loved reading, heavy punch dialogues. I thought Archana is a teacher, engineer, cook, passionate about Tamil. I got to know more and she is much more than that from my observation. To speak the truth if there is someone that I need to get some take away is none other than Archana. Appreciate all your passion. Would love to appreciate Raj for being your side and helping you out and encouraging all your passion.
